Recommended initial convention: | Range | Band | Meaning | |---|---|---| | 0–99 | Emergency | Active severe incident or similarly extraordinary need | | 100–199 | Supercritical | Immediate critical-path or severe operational work | | 200–399 | Critical | Strong near-term need; major blockers or deadlines | | 400–799 | High | Should receive attention ahead of ordinary work | | 800–1199 | Standard / Medium | Normal actionable work | | 1200–1599 | Low | Useful, but not currently time-sensitive | | 1600–1999 | Someday / Deferred | Weakly time-sensitive or speculative work | | 2000+ | Cold backlog | Explicitly retained but not regularly selected | **Default for new, ordinary work: 1000.** Examples: Emergency: 50 Supercritical: 150 Critical: 300 High: 600 Standard: 1000 Low: 1400 Someday: 1800 These are provisional ranges
